description: Istanbul Airport has four parallel-runway pairs on a near-north-south axis (16R/34L, 16L/34R, 17R/35L, 17L/35R), a fifth central north-south runway (18/36) and a single-direction east-west departure runway (09). Headings are the AIP's own 'TRUE BRG' column (AD 2.12) -- an explicit TRUE heading, unlike LSZH/EGCC where the true-vs-magnetic frame had to be inferred from cross-checking two sources. All four parallel-pair runways and 18/36 share essentially the same true heading (179.15 deg / 359.15 deg) since they are physically parallel; 09 points 89.15 deg true and is a single-direction departures-only strip (see modes.json / AD 2.20 'USE OF RWYs'). Threshold coordinates are converted directly from the AIP's own DMS figures (AD 2.12 column 5); THR elevations are also the AIP's own column-6 figures, included here as runway-level description notes since the schema's threshold object has no elevation field.
source: DHMI AIP Turkiye, AD 2 LTFM AD 2.12 'Runway physical characteristics', AIRAC AMDT 11/26 (effective 29 OCT 26), downloaded and read directly this session: https://www.dhmi.gov.tr/AIPDocuments/LT_AD_2_LTFM_en.pdf

runways.name: 16R
runways.description: 3750 x 60 m, asphalt, PCR 1660 F/A/W/T. THR elevation 219 FT (AD 2.12). 16R itself IS permitted for landing; it is the paired runway 34L that is restricted (see 34L).

runways.name: 34L
runways.description: 3750 x 60 m, asphalt, PCR 1660 F/A/W/T. THR elevation 325 FT (AD 2.12).

runways.name: 16L
runways.description: 3750 x 45 m, asphalt, PCR 1600 F/A/W/T. THR elevation 218 FT (AD 2.12). Paired with 34R -- that pair is NOT used for landing (AD 2.20 'USE OF RWYs' #1): 16L is departures-only in this pack's modes.

runways.name: 34R
runways.description: 3750 x 45 m, asphalt, PCR 1600 F/A/W/T. THR elevation 325 FT (AD 2.12). 'Unless otherwise authorized by ATS authority, RWYs 16L/34R and 17R/35L will not be used for landing purposes' (AD 2.20 'USE OF RWYs' #1) -- 34R is departures-only in this pack's modes.

runways.name: 17R
runways.description: 4100 x 45 m, asphalt, PCR 1550 F/A/W/T. THR elevation 202 FT (AD 2.12). Landing-restricted pair with 35L (AD 2.20 'USE OF RWYs' #1) -- 17R is departures-only in this pack's modes.

runways.name: 35L
runways.description: 4100 x 45 m, asphalt, PCR 1550 F/A/W/T. THR elevation 310 FT (AD 2.12). Paired with 17R -- that pair is NOT used for landing (AD 2.20 'USE OF RWYs' #1).
